cloudcli_base_url.hint: The URL where CloudCLI UI is running, for example http://127.0.0.1:3001.

cloudcli_jwt_token.hint: Optional. If empty, the plugin will try username/password login.

cloudcli_username.hint: Optional. Used to login to /api/auth/login when cloudcli_jwt_token is empty.

cloudcli_password.hint: Optional. Used to login to /api/auth/login when cloudcli_jwt_token is empty.

cloudcli_api_key.hint: Optional. Required only if CloudCLI server was started with API_KEY.

allow_unauthenticated_ws.hint: Only enable when CloudCLI is in a trusted platform mode that does not require WS tokens.

recent_sessions_limit.description: Max recent sessions shown by /cloudcli session

chat_messages_limit.description: Default recent messages shown by /cloudcli chat

max_run_message_length.description: Max task length accepted by /cloudcli run

run_status_interval_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between background run status pushes

max_run_status_pushes.description: Max status push messages for one /cloudcli run task
